title: Azure Storage Access Keys & SAS Token Abuse

theory.intro: Azure Storage Access Keys & SAS Token Abuse is a core security discipline in AZURE cloud operations.

sections.heading: Understanding Azure Storage Access Keys & SAS Token Abuse
sections.content: In modern cloud environments, proper configuration of Azure Storage Access Keys & SAS Token Abuse ensures privilege boundaries and access controls prevent unauthorized resource manipulation.

sections.heading: Security Risks & Attack Vectors
sections.content: Misconfigurations related to Azure Storage Access Keys & SAS Token Abuse allow attackers to perform unauthorized reconnaissance, privilege escalation, and persistent access within your cloud tenant.

sections.heading: Defense & Mitigation Strategies
sections.content: Enforce strict principle of least privilege, continuous auditing via CloudTrail/Config, and automated guardrails.
